en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abi al-Mi’za from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:

One who regularly recites: Surah Ghashiya in his obligatory and recommended prayers, Allah’s mercy would pervade him in this world as well as the next, and on the Day of Judgment, Allah would keep that man safe and protected from the chastisement of fire.
